## 🧪 Validation evidence

- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.

## 🔐 Data, privacy, and platform compliance

- [ ] Source terms and permitted access method were reviewed.
- [ ] No CAPTCHA, access-control, or rate-limit bypass was added.
- [ ] No reviewer names, locations, profile links, or contact details were added.
- [ ] No secrets, cookies, tokens, or private datasets were committed.
- [ ] Notebook outputs were inspected for sensitive content.
- [ ] Data retention and publication implications are documented.
